notes.title: Upcoming patch & Editor Mode ?
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!

We wanted to share some information about the upcoming patch but also ask your opinion on a new feature that we might add in the future.

So here are the details.

Upcoming Patch: 

- Mouse sensitivity in options
- Zoom In & Out Option
- Optimized physics for slower machines
- Rounded corners in 3D models

We plan to add an editor mode in the future, so that people can make their own puzzles and share them with other players. 
What do you think about that? Would you be interested in that feature?

Don’t hesitate to leave us a comment or question. 

Thank you
